e.title: insurance-cure
e.summary: 混合 cure 模型（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：协变量感知逻辑发生率 + 参数化治愈时间，非索赔者评分
e.summary_en: Mixture cure models (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): covariate-aware logistic incidence, parametric cure time, non-claimer scoring
e.summary_hk: 混合 cure 模型（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：協變量感知邏輯發生率 + 參數化治癒時間，非索賠者評分
e.body: insurance-cure（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）实现混合 cure 模型：协变量感知的逻辑发生率（是否会发生索赔）+ 参数化治愈时间（多久后算「治愈」）——车险结构零索赔者建模。对 RIAA：结构零（从不索赔的司机）与偶发零（今年没索赔）的区分是车险频率建模的关键——[[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]]（神经泊松混合）是 NN 路线、cure 模型是生存分析路线；与 [[insurance-survival]]（综合包）配套；「治愈率」概念在客户价值（CLV）与留存建模中同样适用。
e.body_en: insurance-cure (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) implements mixture cure models: covariate-aware logistic incidence (whether a claim will happen) + parametric cure time (after how long one is 'cured') — modelling structural zero-claimers in motor. For RIAA: distinguishing structural zeros (drivers who never claim) from occasional zeros (no claim this year) is key to motor frequency modelling — [[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]] (neural Poisson mixture) is the NN route, cure models are the survival-analysis route; pairs with [[insurance-survival]] (integrated suite); the 'cure rate' concept also applies to customer value (CLV) and retention modelling.
e.body_hk: insurance-cure（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）實現混合 cure 模型：協變量感知的邏輯發生率（是否會發生索賠）+ 參數化治癒時間（多久後算「治癒」）——車險結構零索賠者建模。對 RIAA：結構零（從不索賠的司機）與偶發零（今年沒索賠）的區分是車險頻率建模的關鍵——[[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]]（神經泊松混合）是 NN 路線、cure 模型是生存分析路線；與 [[insurance-survival]]（綜合包）配套；「治癒率」概念在客戶價值（CLV）與留存建模中同樣適用。
